story: Nifty 50 opened at 25,277, flat from the previous close of 25,291.
The index dipped to a low of 25,269 (-0.09%) around 9:15 AM and touched a high of 25,501 (+0.83%) around 12:10 PM.
It settled at 25,387 (+0.38%), in the middle of the day's range, a session of two-way trade.
26 of the 50 Nifty stocks advanced and 23 declined; Bank Nifty outperformed (+1.13%).
Latest institutional data (13 Nov): FII/FPI net +5737 Cr, DII net -2254 Cr.
risks: Wall Street trades through tonight (from about 7:00 PM IST); the S&P 500 last closed at 7,416.59 (-1.92%), so US data and Fed commentary can swing the opening.
Brent crude is at US$92.42 (-0.02%); no sharp move so far, but it is a swing factor for inflation and the rupee.
Currency and yields to track: USD/INR 93.460 (-0.83%), US 10-year yield 5.12% (-0.64%). A firmer dollar or higher US yields usually weigh on foreign flows.
GIFT Nifty keeps trading into the late evening, now 25,387.5 (+0.00% vs Nifty's close): the best live read on the next opening.
